component.name: GoldenEye: Source Installer
component.summary: Install GoldenEye: Source for Linux via Steam

description.p: GoldenEye: Source is a free fan-made recreation of the classic GoldenEye 007 N64 multiplayer experience, built on Valve's Source SDK 2013 engine.

This installer places your GES content into the correct Steam sourcemods directory and walks you through the necessary Steam configuration to get the game running — natively on Linux if Linux binaries are present, or through Steam Proton (Windows compatibility layer) otherwise.
